aiSummary: 今日聚焦国际政治领域。热点议题包括：US president Donald Trump says；Canada Outlines Which Foreigners Can；Trump says Ukraine needs 'new。本日共收录 10 条重要国际新闻。

articles.title: US president Donald Trump says it is time for Ukraine to get rid of Zelenskiy
articles.description: Extraordinary intervention came after Russian strikes killed at least 20 people in Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia region

articles.title: Canada Outlines Which Foreigners Can Join Its Military Without Citizenship
articles.description: Canada allows eligible permanent residents to apply to join the Canadian Armed Forces without first becoming citizens. Applicants must meet specific conditions.

articles.title: Trump says Ukraine needs 'new president', warns Zelensky a day after Russia diesel deal
articles.description: Trump warned Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky against attacking Russian oil refineries, particularly facilities that produce diesel fuel. | World News

articles.title: Photos: Thousands march across Europe to demand end to Israel’s war on Gaza
articles.description: Demonstrations in London, Berlin, and Rome denounce ongoing Israeli attacks on Gaza ‘ceasefire’ anniversary.

articles.title: Hurricane Isaias kills at least four, thousands without power after making landfall in US
articles.description: Four people are dead and about 800,000 in south-eastern US states are without power after Hurricane Isaias made landfall, weakening to a post-tropical cyclone.
articles.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation

articles.title: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs urges Latvian citizens not to travel to Saudi Arabia
articles.description: Latvian citizens who are already in Saudi Arabia are urged to follow the instructions of local authorities.

articles.title: ‘Time for a new president’: Trump calls on Zelensky to go amid diesel stoush
articles.description: The US president said Ukraine “better damn well stop” striking Russia’s diesel refineries and called for Zelensky to be replaced with someone who would make a deal with Vladimir Putin.

articles.title: Donald Trump weighs joint strikes on Houthis and calls for Volodymyr Zelensky to be replaced
articles.description: Trump's remarks leave open the possibility of direct US military involvement alongside Saudi Arabia against the Houthis. He also added that he thought 'it's time for Ukraine to get a new president.'

articles.title: Houthi attack on Riyadh airport kills 12, wounds 300
articles.description: Houthi attack on Riyadh airport kills 12 and wounds more than 300, Saudi authorities say, as flights are diverted and operations suspended. Read more at straitstimes.com.

articles.title: Nine dead, including shooter, in Pennsylvania
articles.description: Two children were among the eight people killed at a residential home in Erie. Police have described the mass shooting as one of the worst in the city’s history.
